[color=Red][b][size=5]This mod is no longer maintained and may not work in newer game versions.[/size][/b][/color]


[s]This is an external editor for the game. Currently, only events (in English) are supported.

To connect the editor to the game, install the "StardewEditorGameIntegration"
SMAPI mod that is included. Then, open the editor, and type 'editor_connect' in the game console.[/s]
